description: Michigan LARA Corporations Division business entity bulk data (access review; no bulk entity file found) for the FactLot Registry collector. See docs/registry/sources/mi-sos-entities.md.

sources.publisher: Michigan Department of Licensing and Regulatory Affairs (LARA), Corporations Division (MiBusiness Registry Portal)
sources.gate: No bulk entity product was found on any readable page, free or sold. LARA's CSCL 'License List and Data' request form covers licensees (xlsx by email), not corporate entities; aggregate 'Total Business Entities' counts are published but are counts, not records. michigan.gov (Akamai) answered the collector with HTTP 403 'Access Denied', including /robots.txt, so the Corporations Division pages could not be read directly. A person should ask the Corporations Division (517-241-6470) whether a bulk entity file exists, or file a Michigan FOIA request through LARA.
sources.ai_use: Not addressed on any page read
sources.redistribution: Not addressed on any page read
sources.notes: The Business Entity Search moved to the MiBusiness Registry Portal in June 2025 (www.michigan.gov/corpentitysearch); it is interactive and is not scraped. A vendor (Topograph) says Michigan publishes no bulk corporate extract; another vendor page claims a 'bulk export to CSV' in its own product, which is not LARA's. Findings come from search-index snippets of michigan.gov pages, not direct reads. Nothing was purchased and no request was sent.
